observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor stage with a white screen and black curtains in the background, theatrical performance setting
observation.dancers: mixed group of about ten children and teenagers, male and female, dancing together as an ensemble
observation.formation_and_space: line formation across the front of the stage, shifting into pairs and facing each other, moving dynamically across the performance space
observation.posture: upright torso with a slight forward lean, knees bent and bouncy, weight shifting continuously
observation.footwork: fast, rhythmic stepping and shifting of weight on the beat, low to the ground with nimble foot lifts
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held out to the sides or bent at the elbows with hands gesturing, sometimes raised overhead or linked with partners
observation.hips_and_torso: rapid hip shimmies and vibrations coordinated with the fast rhythm of the music
observation.partnering: temporary holds and facing pairs without continuous close physical contact
observation.levels_jumps_turns: low to mid-level body posture with bouncing knees, small turns in place and traveling
observation.costume_and_props: colorful layered skirts with red, yellow, and white bands, white and colored tops, headbands, and dark shoes
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement and micro-weight shifts are partially obscured by long skirts and low video resolution

signature_moments.what: dancers line up with bent knees and rapid hip shaking while stepping side to side
dancers raise arms out and bounce rhythmically while the drummers play an intensified beat
dancers pair up, facing each other and holding hands while stepping in a circle
